interactions.teaches: See the film's version and the real people side by side before reading on.
interactions.studentAction: Tap a frame to load the trailer or the 60 Minutes segment.
interactions.feedback: The frame becomes a YouTube player in place.
interactions.staticFallback: Each video has an Open on YouTube link and the chapter text stands alone.
interactions.identityFit: Reel frame in teal, real frame in amber.

interactions.teaches: The stadium was built near the top of the oil boom and the season was played near the bottom.
interactions.feedback: The year's oil price lights up on the chart and a line says what happened in Odessa that year.
interactions.staticFallback: Every year is listed as text in the chart's data table.
interactions.identityFit: Amber price line on a black field with yard line gridlines.

interactions.teaches: The size of football spending compared to a classroom budget.
interactions.studentAction: Guess how many English budgets one season of chartered jets would cost, then reveal.
interactions.feedback: Stacked blocks at true scale, each one an English budget, with the real answer of about 14 and how close the guess was.
interactions.staticFallback: The four dollar figures are printed beside the blocks before and after the reveal.
interactions.identityFit: Ledger paper blocks in red ink.

interactions.teaches: A season decided by chance, and why each team had the same odds.
interactions.studentAction: Flip three coins, or run 300 tiebreakers at once.
interactions.feedback: Coins land, the odd coin is knocked out, matching coins force a reflip, and a tally shows each team out about one time in three.
interactions.staticFallback: The rule and the real result are written out in full.
interactions.identityFit: Silver coins on a dark Midland night band.

interactions.teaches: How a court fight over one grade decided who held a state title.
interactions.studentAction: Step forward and back through nine dated docket entries.
interactions.feedback: Each step shows the ruling and moves the trophy marker between Carter and nobody.
interactions.staticFallback: All nine entries are a readable ordered list.
interactions.identityFit: Courier docket sheet with a trophy marker.

interactions.teaches: How a true story film changes events, and the difference between invented and moved details.
interactions.studentAction: Call nine claims History, Hollywood or Remixed.
interactions.feedback: A stamp, the real record and a running count of what the film changed.
interactions.staticFallback: Every verdict is plain text after a button press.
interactions.identityFit: Teal reel cards with amber stamps.

interactions.teaches: Weigh who paid the most for the season.
interactions.studentAction: Move six line items up or down the receipt.
interactions.feedback: The receipt reorders and the top line is carried into the final question.
interactions.staticFallback: The list is readable and works with buttons only, no dragging.
interactions.identityFit: Perforated receipt in Courier with red ink totals.

interactions.teaches: Argue with evidence from the chapters.
interactions.identityFit: Ledger cards with varsity question numbers.

interactions.teaches: Watch the real 1988 coin flip that the film recreates.
interactions.studentAction: Tap the frame to play the footage.
interactions.feedback: The facade becomes a YouTube player.
interactions.staticFallback: Open on YouTube link and full text account.

interactions.teaches: See the real Permian and Carter teams play the 1988 semifinal and hear Carter's side of the story.
interactions.studentAction: Tap a frame to play the game footage or the What Carter Lost trailer.
interactions.feedback: The facade becomes a YouTube player.
interactions.staticFallback: Open on YouTube links and full text account.
